hero.title: Empyrean Beauty
hero.subtitle: Beauty Parlor
hero.intro: Meaning “heaven-like.” Hair extensions are our specialty — backed by twenty-three years of craft, sustainable product, and the most elevated chair in Montgomery County.

intro.heading: 23+ Years of Experience
intro.body: Empyrean Beauty is a beauty parlor in New Caney, TX, specializing in hair extensions — hand-tied and sew-in wefts, I-tips and K-tips. With over 23 years of experience and certifications, plus cut, colour and treatments under one roof, we guarantee you the most elevated experience in the area.

booking.heading: Book your visit today.
booking.body: We're by appointment only, so book online and your chair will be ready when you arrive. We can't wait to see you!

testimonials.quote: Thank you so much for going out of your way and helping me get this color. It is like a treasure in these difficult times.
testimonials.author: Sonia T.
